analyst_lean.rationale: Denver's offense meets New Orleans' weak season defensive efficiency. New Orleans lists Trey Murphy III and Dejounte Murray OUT, and is on a back-to-back after losing to Memphis; Denver won their prior two meetings this season.
analyst_lean.counterargument: Pelicans play faster, draw many free throws and Denver's perimeter defense can surrender threes; two H2H games are a very small sample.

analyst_lean.rationale: Cleveland's high three-point attempt volume and higher current ORtg support home upside, but the Cavaliers played Miami on Friday and their game-specific official injury submission was still missing in the reviewed report. Dallas's defense has performed better in the accepted sample.
analyst_lean.counterargument: Dereck Lively II is confirmed OUT, Max Christie DOUBTFUL, and Cleveland has home court. These give reasons not to infer a Dallas win from the competing defensive/availability evidence.

analyst_lean.rationale: CONDITIONAL contrarian lean: Detroit's Jalen Duren is confirmed OUT, weakening the interior/rebounding rotation, while Miami lists Giannis Antetokounmpo PROBABLE and has Bam Adebayo. Their paint pressure is a plausible opponent-specific challenge to the average-strength baseline.
analyst_lean.counterargument: Giannis is PROBABLE, not confirmed active; Detroit has a much stronger current-season defense, already beat Miami this season, and Miami is on a back-to-back.

analyst_lean.rationale: Memphis has a much stronger accepted-sample offense and defense; season-preview team boxes show roughly 39 percent Memphis three-point accuracy versus high Brooklyn turnover volume. This is a meaningful shooting/possession matchup advantage.
analyst_lean.counterargument: Memphis played on November 13 and its game-specific official injury report was not yet submitted at review; Brooklyn could benefit from tired legs and three-point variance.

analyst_lean.rationale: Minnesota's accepted-sample defense (DRtg about 101.9) meets Chicago's very poor defense (DRtg about 119.2), and Chicago had to play overtime the previous night. The Wolves' defensive/rebounding identity remains a concrete advantage.
analyst_lean.counterargument: Anthony Edwards and Donte DiVincenzo are confirmed OUT. Edwards was a +5.3 DPM / +5.4 offensive DPM player in a dated DARKO profile; Chicago may exploit missing shot creation and high-variance perimeter scoring. Norman Powell, Nic Claxton, and Jalen Smith are QUESTIONABLE, not confirmed OUT.
